message: 天使の痕跡

name: Melilot
message: 「Once Re-Crea reaches a certain level, that magic circle's magic circuits will open and boost Re-Crea. Its other functions appear to be secondary.」

name: Helena
message: 「Other functions?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Functions designed with me as a hypothetical enemy. I believe they were added later.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whoever accesses that magic circle can control roughly ninety percent of the flow of magical power within this academy--no, throughout all of Ryuusei Town.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. So if you can control the flow of magical power--」
The ball struck by Helena's cue cleanly knocked four others aside, pocketing every single one.

name: Helena
message: 「You can dominate the battlefield just like this.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You make it look effortless.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hardly. Between the approaching Re-Crea and the approaching Holy Night Festival, it's been absolute chaos.」

name: Helena
message: 「See? I missed.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That looked terribly deliberate.」

name: Helena
message: 「So, what's the verdict?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As far as controlling magical power goes, there are any number of loopholes. For me, at least.」

name: Helena
message: 「Loopholes? Can't you just destroy the magic circle and be done with it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Regarding that, I have one piece of bad news.」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't tell me it's indestructible?」

name: Helena
message: 「No way! Are you serious?」

name: Melilot
message: 「A seal to prevent its destruction has been placed upon that magic circle.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so, someone like you could--」

name: Melilot
message: 「The seal was woven using pure Spirit Power.」

name: Helena
message: 「Demons can't read pure Spirit Power... That's right, isn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely.」

name: Helena
message: 「You can't read it at all? Shouldn't you be able to read it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Certainly, it is not impossible to read given enough time. However...」

name: Helena
message: 「You won't make it in time, then」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is correct.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hold on a second. If it's woven from pure Spirit Power, that means...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The one who placed the seal was an angel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That just now was truly a blunder.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, yeah... I never expected an angel to be cooperating with them」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though I suspect there is a high likelihood they are being threatened」

name: Helena
message: 「...That's the worst. So that's why they made contact with that kid」

name: Melilot
message: 「So it would seem.」

name: Helena
message: 「Can an angel undo it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As long as they read it for me, I can handle undoing the seal. However, it will take a bit of time」

name: Helena
message: 「Specifically?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Five days will be sufficient.」

name: Helena
message: 「What about the one who actually placed the seal?」

name: Melilot
message: 「One day should suffice. However, do you really expect that much from him?」

name: Helena
message: 「I trust them. Both him and you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Me as well?」

name: Helena
message: 「You're pretty fond of Azel, aren't you」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is simply a student who happens to use the library frequently.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm」
